== Summary ==
Identified: [[Justin Branch]] (orange tee, salt-and-pepper hair; same face as [[:File:Justin Branch 2022 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 European Championship Team Wales 10.jpg]]) and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (black graphic tee; same face as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 19.jpg]]).

Main event at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 3 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 3 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-04
* '''Identification:''' [[Justin Branch]] (orange tee, salt-and-pepper hair; same face as [[:File:Justin Branch 2022 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 European Championship Team Wales 10.jpg]]) and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (black graphic tee; same face as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 19.jpg]]).
